commentBody:
Formal scan 1 is **CHANGES REQUIRED** at `993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd`, tree `77f0af8c8276fba6761f3bc63bfa12a2d706ffa4`, effective comparison parent `bf9f287652a23177b87488df110dfd6147acaad0`. Independent reviewer: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh, reviewing Claude UI work. The full original static report is retained unchanged (SHA-256 `c05e27490c8a1299d5fc697d3393ae754b03cd858fef7fedf51f48efc506585d`) for evidence publication. It ran no native probe, test or build.

Root read the full report and the affected Canvas/store/load/conflict paths. Dispositions:

- **F1 — FIX-IN-PR:** require a unique current edge identity at the shared removal boundary and a matching visible refusal. A publicly storable duplicate ID currently reaches a first-match protection check followed by removal of every matching record. Verify unchanged graph/history/save state for ambiguous records, ordinary unique removal and protected-holder ordering. The possible protected-Chat bypass remains a source/local-guard concern until actual public Chat admission is established; ordinary ambiguous multi-removal already violates the contract.
- **F2 — FIX-IN-PR:** bind selection to the loaded draft and current drawable connection. Reloading a valid server draft can reuse a selected ID for different endpoints; removing a selected port can also leave an invisible stored edge as the keyboard deletion target. Clear/refuse stale context while preserving selection through ordinary non-topology edits and normal node/edge keyboard behavior.
- **Placement follow-up — DEFER-ISSUE:** [#479](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/479) records the witnessed partial selected-toolbar clipping after default Fit view, with ordinary pan/zoom recovery. It is parked outside the required corrections.
- **Control-node-drag click overlap — still unproven:** existing native timing establishes a reachable control but both later clicks arrived after the D3 blocker cleared. The bounded trusted-input probe remains an engineering evidence task, not a waiver or an assertion that overlap cannot occur.

Before the correction, independent exact-source native QA will exercise the known identity failures and the one discriminating post-drag probe using isolated fixtures. A fresh build is required because the existing local artifact is the earlier `bc909` runtime. Claude will implement the UI correction after the evidence is captured; GPT architecture, opposite-family review and independent QA remain separate.

One of three formal scans is consumed. This disposition is not a new scan or final Astra sign-off. Current CI, final actual-main parent delivery/retargeting, corrected native verification and fresh final audit remain required. Owner acceptance stays open on #207; no scope gate is waived.

pr.body:
Part of #207. Owner acceptance and closure remain on that issue.

Connections are authored on the canvas. Every selected edge has a visible Remove connection action; invalid stored endpoints and retired ports can be removed through Loop issues. Declaration editing and connected-route confirmations stay in node configuration. The modal Connections section and its keyboard creation form are removed; canvas navigation and keyboard deletion remain. [ADR-0076](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/decisions/ADR-0076-canvas-only-connection-authoring.md) records that boundary.

## Current corrected stack

Draft head `993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd`, tree `77f0af8c8276fba6761f3bc63bfa12a2d706ffa4`, was integrated and reviewed against PR #475 at `bf9f287652a23177b87488df110dfd6147acaad0`. The parent branch has since advanced to `30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348` through native-evidence publication and a wrapper newline/checksum correction only; those later metadata commits must still be integrated here. That parent includes actual main `8fadcb0d44ac2caf80ff6279fe4648ce9398afd9`. #475 still must merge before this PR retargets to main and completes its final gates.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh corrected both confirmed release blockers: the first enabled connection action could be swallowed after a mouse pan, and a blank Decision route ID could strand a stored edge without a recovery action. The Canvas-owned pan gate keeps Remove/Reset attached and focusable while unavailable, then releases them after the installed D3 click blocker clears. Recovery reads exact unique stored undrawable edges even when schema validation cannot produce edge-ID diagnostics. Existing invalid-data refusals, identity checks and protected Chat guards remain.

The corrected child was frozen at `bc9094fd`. Parent integration `259b10fa` retained all 47 combined product paths and 20,495 inherited QA blobs; the only product overlap was the node dialog, which automatically combines the parent's in-place reference repair with this PR's modal retirement. Integration checks passed 196 tests across 13 files, no-emit types, scoped lint and formatting. The final merge of parent evidence into this head changed no product, test or build inputs.

## Verification and limits

- [Correction source evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-final-correction/README.md): 203 focused tests and static checks passed. Old-source controls reproduced the pan ordering and blank-route recovery failures. The worker's immediately reverted intent-to-add incident is retained; root verified the empty index before its own staging.
- [Independent corrected-stack native QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-correction-independent/README.md): actual Edge, compiled API and file SQLite verified pan availability and the first tested available action, Remove/Reset/Undo, blank-ID device ownership/recovery, coarse input and protected Chat. Ten fixtures recorded no page errors; eight successful cases made 36 accepted browser PUTs. The two affected repository Edge tests separately passed 2/2 first attempt, zero retries. All 85 source paths, 18 embedded modules and 1,227 artifacts across 13 trees matched before/after, with cleanup verified.
- A bounded Control-drag witness established that selected-edge Remove can remain reachable. Both subsequent clicks arrived after D3's short blocker cleared; the immediate tested click worked at +12.1 ms. Overlap remains inconclusive and is explicitly assigned to formal review. This is no waiver or general node-drag fix.
- [Original pan failure](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-post-pan-cause/README.md), first fixture errors and [initial CI failure](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-initial-ci/README.md) remain intact. Original Browser CI had 478 passes, one expected provider skip and one migrated Decision-route failure, without retries; the other four jobs passed.
- Eight reviewed child packets retain 515 exact files totaling 28,348,076 bytes. Earlier phase/native evidence keeps its historical scope. Current-parent native verification and new CI remain pending; the older compiled runtime is not silently promoted to the current source.
- Formal scan 1, independent GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh, returned **CHANGES REQUIRED**. Root accepted F1 (ambiguous edge IDs can remove multiple records) and F2 (stale selection can target replacement or undrawable connections) for correction. [Root dispositions](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/478#issuecomment-6886454200) preserve the original report identity and qualified evidence. The separate partial Fit view placement issue is parked in [#479](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/479). Exact-source negative behavior QA, including the one remaining node-drag overlap probe, precedes the Claude correction. One of three scans is consumed; corrected native QA, final current-main integration/CI and fresh Astra remain required.

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the merged build and observations on #207. Confirm that drawing, selecting and removing connections is understandable; declaration editing and connected-route confirmations are discoverable; and Loop issues makes stranded-connection recovery clear. The removed modal keyboard creation path is an explicit scope change. Machine-verifiable correctness, keyboard guards, focus and pointer behavior remain pipeline responsibilities. No owner instance/store change or owner acceptance is claimed.

issue.title: Keep selected connection actions hittable after Fit view
issue.body:
Follow-up from PR #478's first GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh review at `993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd` (F3/P3 placement follow-up), within #207's canvas connection-authoring surface.

Native Edge QA observed a selected Decision edge whose Remove connection centre was clipped or failed hit testing after the default Fit view. Ordinary zoom/pan made it reachable and the settled action worked. The evidence establishes partial clipping with a recovery path; it does not establish that every point of the control was inaccessible. This is separate from the canceled post-pan click and the required ambiguous/stale-selection fixes.

The selected toolbar is positioned above the edge label in screen pixels and travels with the viewport. [Placement source](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/apps/web/src/editor/OrthogonalEdge.tsx#L330) · [Original native observations](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-postdeletion-independent/raw/native-stacked-report.md.txt) · [Corrected pan and placement controls](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-correction-independent/raw/corrected-stacked-native-report.md.txt)

Acceptance:

- Reproduce the actual selected-edge placement after default Fit view at desktop, narrow/reflow and coarse-pointer sizes; distinguish centre clipping, partial clipping and fully unreachable controls.
- Keep the selected action visibly discoverable and genuinely hittable in the reproduced default-fit case, using the existing design system and preserving node/handle interactions.
- Preserve connection selection, Remove/Reset behavior, focus, keyboard guards, one-step history, saved geometry and shared gesture availability.
- Verify native hit targets before and after ordinary pan/zoom, both themes and 44 px coarse targets. A synthetic click or a screenshot alone is insufficient.
- Preserve current repository gates and update numbered user-facing behavior documentation if placement changes.

P3 follow-up parked outside PR #478's required correctness correction. Searches for toolbar/Fit, Remove connection and edge clipping found #207 and broader historical issues but no matching bounded placement issue. Future delivery: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh UI design/implementation, GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh opposite-family review, independent touched-system QA and applicable final audit. No implementation is dispatched here.
